fields.title: Analyze a Cascade
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: The reviews service started responding in 25 seconds. After 10 minutes the catalog stopped opening, after 15 minutes — the main screen. Trace the mechanics and name three safeguards.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: catalog calls reviews for rating, waits 25 seconds without a timeout, connections are held up and run out, catalog stops responding entirely; main screen calls catalog — the same thing repeats. Safeguards: short timeout on reviews call, connection pool cutoff, "page without rating" stub plus an emergency switch. The root cause is trivial, the scale was created by propagation — this is the defining characteristic of a cascade.
